Package cafe94.system.controller.customer

Class CustomerBookingController

java.lang.Object
cafe94.system.controller.customer.CustomerBookingController
public class CustomerBookingController extends Object
Controller for handling customer bookings in Cafe94. Allows customers to request a table, view current bookings, and cancel if needed.

      private void setupTableColumns()
      Configures the cell value factories for each column in the booking table. This determines how each cell displays booking data.

      Handles the submission of a new booking request. Validates input, creates a booking, saves it, and updates the UI with a confirmation message.

      Handles the cancellation of a selected booking. Prompts for confirmation and updates the status if approved.
